source.notes: No existing site to harvest. Business details supplied by the owner; palette and house rules from the AvoSolution Document Design System v1.0 (Aug 2026); logo masters from the supplied logo pack.

business.name: AvoSolution
business.description: AvoSolution is a UK software development and consultancy studio. We design and build websites, and develop bespoke applications for commerce, service management and customer engagement.

brand.voice: Direct and unhyped, per the design system house rules: plain language, no emoji, one accent colour, at most one highlighted phrase per heading, and no invented credentials.

hero.headline: Software built around your business, not the other way round
hero.subhead: From the website customers see to the systems your team runs on — designed and built to fit how you actually work.

about.heading: One studio, design through to deployment
body: AvoSolution runs two streams that feed each other. One designs and builds websites. The other develops bespoke software — applications, commerce platforms and service management systems for businesses whose needs have outgrown off-the-shelf tools.

Keeping both under one roof means the site that wins the customer and the system that serves them are designed together, by the same people, rather than handed between an agency and a development shop.
Alongside client work we are building Avo, our own platform for appointment-led businesses — a branded customer portal that keeps the customer relationship with the business that earned it.

valueProps.title: Bespoke, not templated
valueProps.text: Work starts from how your business actually operates, not from a theme that has to be bent into shape around it.

valueProps.title: Design and engineering together
valueProps.text: The same studio handles the interface and the system behind it, so there is no gap between what was designed and what gets built.

valueProps.title: Clear on what you own
valueProps.text: Bespoke work belongs to you. Our own products, Avo among them, we license — and we say which of the two you are getting before any work starts. Websites you can take and run yourself, or leave with us to maintain.

closingCta.heading: Tell us what you are trying to build
closingCta.text: A short conversation is usually enough to tell whether this is a website, an application, or something in between.

services.name: Web design
services.summary: Websites designed and built from scratch — fast, accessible, and shaped around what the business needs the site to do.
description: Every site is designed for the business it belongs to rather than assembled from a template. That starts with what the site is for — winning enquiries, taking bookings, explaining a complicated service — and works back to the layout and the copy from there.

Sites are built to be quick on a phone on a bad connection, and to meet accessibility standards rather than merely claim to. When it is finished you can take it and run it yourself, or leave it with us to maintain — the site is yours either way.
features: Designed around the site's actual job
Fast and accessible on any device
Yours to run, or maintained by us

services.name: Bespoke application development
services.summary: Custom applications for businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and off-the-shelf software.
description: When a process only half fits the tool it runs on, the workarounds cost more than the software ever did. Bespoke development replaces that with a system built around the real workflow.
Work is scoped in stages, so there is something usable early and the direction can change before the budget is spent.
Bespoke work belongs to the client who commissioned it. Where a piece of what we build is one of our own licensed products rather than bespoke, we say so before the work starts.
features: Integrates with the tools you already run

services.name: Commerce
services.summary: Online stores and commerce systems, including the stock, pricing and fulfilment logic behind the storefront.
description: A storefront is the visible part of a commerce system. The parts that decide whether it works — stock, pricing rules, delivery options, the handover into fulfilment and accounts — sit behind it.
We build both, whether that means a well-configured platform or a custom system where the rules are too particular for one.

services.name: Service management systems
services.summary: Bespoke systems for businesses that run work in the field or by appointment — scheduling, customer records, quoting and invoicing built to fit.
description: Businesses built on appointments and repeat custom tend to run on several disconnected front doors: a marketplace, a phone, a social inbox, a paper diary. Each keeps a fragment of the story, and none of them adds up to a single view of a customer.
We build the layer that joins them up — one customer record behind booking, history, reminders, loyalty and memberships, under the business' own brand rather than someone else'.
That means the relationship, the history and the means to reach a customer stay with the business that earned them.
features: Booking and customer records in one place

services.name: Avo
services.summary: Our own platform: a branded customer portal for appointment-led businesses, with booking, loyalty, memberships and messaging against a single customer record.
description: Businesses built on appointments and repeat custom tend to arrive with the same problem. Customers come in through a marketplace or a social inbox, the visit goes well, and then the relationship goes back to whoever made the introduction rather than staying with the business that earned it.

Avo is our answer to that. It is a customer portal carrying the business' own brand, where customers book, see their history, collect loyalty, manage memberships and stay in touch in one place. Every one of those actions writes to a single customer record that belongs to the business.

Avo is our own product, licensed rather than built bespoke. It is in active development with a small group of founding partners who are shaping what gets built. If your business runs on appointments and repeat custom, we would like to hear from you.
features: A customer portal under your own brand
One customer record, owned by you

seo.title: AvoSolution | Web design and bespoke software development
seo.description: AvoSolution is a UK software development and consultancy studio: websites, bespoke applications, commerce and customer engagement systems for appointment-led businesses.

gaps: No existing site, socials or marketing material was available to harvest. Business positioning comes from a short description by the owner; brand comes from the AvoSolution Document Design System v1.0.
The design system is a document/deck spec (fixed 1456x819 slides rendered to PDF). Its palette, logo and house rules transfer to the website; its fixed-position slide layout does not.
No contact details, service area, founding year, team, client work, testimonials or FAQs have been supplied yet.

Three internal documents were supplied for context (an investor deck, a founding partner proposal and a customer journey deck). All three are marked CONFIDENTIAL. Nothing from them is published: no pricing, ROI modelling, market sizing, roadmap, customer names or competitor names. They were used only to correct the category line and sharpen the service-management positioning.
The founding partner programme is approved for public mention (owner, 30 Aug 2026). Its pricing, ROI modelling and partner list remain confidential and are not published.

Ownership model confirmed by the owner (30 Aug 2026): bespoke work belongs to the client; AvoSolution licenses its own products (Avo); websites can be handed over outright or maintained by AvoSolution.
